Prompt

Create a modern SaaS landing page for a project management tool called "TaskFlow". Include these sections:

1. HERO SECTION
- Headline: "Manage Projects Smarter, Not Harder"
- Subheadline explaining the value proposition
- Primary CTA "Start Free Trial" and secondary CTA "Watch Demo"
- Hero image showing the dashboard interface

2. SOCIAL PROOF BAR
- Logos of 5 well-known companies
- Text: "Trusted by 10,000+ teams worldwide"

3. FEATURES SECTION (3-column grid)
- Task Management: Kanban boards, lists, calendars
- Team Collaboration: Real-time editing, comments, @mentions
- Analytics Dashboard: Progress tracking, team performance
- Each feature with icon, title, and 2-line description

4. HOW IT WORKS (3 steps)
- Step 1: Create your workspace
- Step 2: Invite your team
- Step 3: Start managing projects

5. PRICING TABLE (3 tiers)
- Starter: $0/month - For individuals
- Pro: $12/user/month - For small teams
- Enterprise: Custom pricing - For large organizations
- Feature comparison list for each tier

6. TESTIMONIALS (3 cards)
- Customer photo, name, role, company
- Quote about their experience
- Star rating

7. FAQ SECTION (accordion style)
- 5 common questions about the product

8. FINAL CTA SECTION
- "Ready to transform your workflow?"
- Email input + "Get Started Free" button

Design: Clean, modern, lots of whitespace. Primary color: #6366f1 (indigo). Use Inter font.
